review.body:

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.816 of the raw projection. It counts toward Volleyball scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 552 graded Volleyball games the algo now scales scoring ×0.961 and gives home teams +0.2 sets. Team corrections so far: Catamounts attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (5 games); Terriers attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (4 games).
